Essentials 无障碍服务

以下高级功能需要此服务：

• 物理按键重映射：
即使在熄屏状态下也能检测音量键按压，以触发闪光灯等操作。

• 按应用设置：
监控当前前台应用，为动态夜灯、通知灯光颜色和应用锁应用特定配置文件。

• 屏幕控制：
允许应用锁定屏幕（例如通过双击或小部件）并检测屏幕状态变化。

• 安全：
在设备锁定时检测窗口内容，防止未经授权的更改。

不会收集或传输任何输入文本或敏感的用户数据。

使用生物识别认证保护你的应用。被锁定的应用在启动时需要认证，并在屏幕关闭前保持解锁。
请注意，这并非一个可靠的解决方案，因为这只是第三方应用。如果你需要更强的安全性，请考虑使用隐私空间或其他类似功能。
另外请注意，生物识别认证提示只允许使用 STRONG 安全级别的方法。在 Pixel 7 等设备上，WEAK 级别的人脸解锁只能配合指纹或 PIN 等其他可用的 STRONG 认证方法。

面向 Android 极客的工具箱

此应用是多种可以深度交互设备系统的实用工具的合集。使用某些功能可能会以意想不到的方式修改系统设置或行为。

你只需要为正在使用的功能授予必要的权限，从而完全控制应用的行为。

此外，此应用不会跟踪或存储你的任何个人数据，我不需要它们……保护好自己。你可以参考源代码了解更多信息。

此应用完全开源，现在和将来都永远免费使用。不要付费或从未知来源安装。
警告：请谨慎操作。开发者对因使用此应用而导致的任何系统不稳定、数据丢失或其他问题概不负责。继续使用即表示你认可这些风险。
我知道你可能没有仔细阅读这些内容，但如果你需要任何帮助，请随时联系开发者或社区。
当你对某个功能或快捷设置磁贴的作用以及可能需要哪些权限感到困惑时，只需长按它并选择「这是什么？」即可了解更多。

通知灯光会在你收到通知时添加美丽的边缘灯光效果。\n\n你可以自定义动画样式、颜色和行为。即使熄屏（取决于 OEM）或显示在当前应用之上也能工作。从给定的控件中选择应用、通知优先级或触发行为。如果你的 OEM 不支持在 AOD 之上叠加浮层，请使用下方找到的 Ambient display 选项。
轻点透明的可调整大小的小部件即可轻松关闭屏幕，不会在主屏幕上添加图标或任何杂乱内容。

Take full control over your status bar.

Hide individual icons like WiFi, Bluetooth, or cellular data, hide all system or notification icons at once, or only hide system icons while the device is locked. Smart visibility can hide mobile data automatically when WiFi is connected or in certain modes.

You can also show seconds in the clock, change its position or hide it, show the battery percentage, hide the camera and microphone chips, or hide the entire status bar. Some advanced flags need Shizuku or Root.

These are AOSP controls, so your device OS might not respect all of them.
Caffeinate 可防止屏幕自动关闭。\n\n在特定时间内或无限期保持屏幕唤醒。在阅读长文章或参考食谱时非常有用。
在受支持的 Android 设备上，使用极简纯黑背景的 Google 地图省电模式覆盖在锁屏上显示。开始导航会话，关闭屏幕再重新打开。
Pulse the flashlight when you receive a notification.\n\nOn devices with hardware support for flashlight dimming, the pulse is smoothly animated.

增强设备锁定时的安全性。

限制访问某些敏感的 QS 磁贴，防止未经授权的网络修改，并通过提高动画速度来防止触摸刷屏，进一步阻止他们再次尝试。

此功能并不健全，可能存在缺陷，例如某些允许直接切换的磁贴（如蓝牙或飞行模式）无法被阻止。
使用第二层认证保护你的应用。\n\n只要你的设备锁屏认证方法符合 Android 标准的 3 级生物识别安全等级，就会使用它。
当你更接近目的地时收到通知，确保你不会错过下车点。\n\n前往 Google 地图，长按目的地附近的图钉，确保显示「已放置图钉」（否则距离计算可能不准确），然后将位置分享到 Essentials 应用并开始跟踪。

从 Google 地图分享坐标（已放置图钉）到 Essentials 以保存为目的地。

显示的距离是到目的地的直线距离，而不是沿道路的距离。

对时间和距离的所有计算请保持谨慎，因为它们并不总是准确。
冻结应用以阻止它们在后台运行。\n\n完全冻结你不使用的应用，防止电池消耗和数据使用。启动它们时会立即解冻。冻结的应用不会显示在应用抽屉中，也不会在 Play 商店中显示应用更新。
一个没人要求的自定义输入法。\n\n它只是一个实验。多语言可能得不到支持，因为这是一个非常复杂且耗时的实现。
监控所有已连接设备的电池电量。\n\n在一个地方查看你的蓝牙耳机、手表和其他配件的电池状态。连接 AirSync 应用还可以显示你的 Mac 电池电量。
为你的照片添加带有 EXIF 数据和设备信息的自定义说明/水印。\n\n直接从其他应用分享图片到 Essentials 即可轻松添加水印。
同步你所有即将到来的日历日程，不受 Google 账户因工作或学校政策而无法添加到 Wear OS 设备的限制。\n\n请务必安装 Wear OS Essentials 配套应用，以在应用中以及磁贴或表盘中显示日程。

为通话添加触觉反馈。\n\n通话接通、断开或接听时振动，无需看屏幕即可获得触觉确认。
在响铃、振动和静音模式之间快速切换。\n\n一个方便的磁贴，无需使用音量键或设置即可更改铃声模式。你可以重新排序模式或禁用不需要的模式，以自定义磁贴的循环切换行为。

Control the Always On Display from one place. Turn it on or off, and quickly check the time, notifications and other info at a glance while the screen is off.

You can also force it to turn off when there are no notifications, and show your wallpaper behind the clock using an overlay.

Writing secure settings permission is required to toggle it, and accessibility is needed for the force turn off option.

应用锁和锁定安全真的安全吗？

绝对不是。

任何第三方应用都无法 100% 干预正常的设备交互，即使是应用锁也只是一个覆盖在所选应用之上的浮层，用于防止与它们交互。有变通方法，并非万无一失。

锁定安全功能也是如此，它会检测有人试图与网络磁贴交互，在 Pixel 上这些磁贴出于某种原因仍然对任何人开放。所以如果他们足够努力，仍然可能更改它们，尤其是如果你添加了飞行模式 QS 磁贴，此应用无法防止与它交互。

这些功能只是为轻度使用而做的实验，绝不会推荐作为强大的安全和隐私解决方案。

安全替代方案：
 - 应用锁：Pixel 和三星上的隐私空间和安全文件夹
 - 防止移动网络访问：确保你的防盗保护和离线/关机查找我的设备设置已开启。你也可以考虑使用 Graphene OS。
电源和电池设置如何工作？

这些设置直接覆盖 Android 内部的电池保护程序策略常量（特别是全局设置表属性：battery_saver_constants）。

当 Android 激活电池保护模式时，它会读取这些键以确定应限制哪些系统功能（例如降低屏幕亮度、禁用 AOD、限制 GPS 位置访问或将应用置于休眠状态）。

如果你修改这些值，你的自定义电池保护策略将在下次开启电池保护程序时生效。你可以随时使用屏幕底部的按钮重置为默认值。写入这些系统配置需要 WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS 权限。
微调 Android 内部的电池保护程序常量策略。自定义开启电池保护程序时的行为，例如亮度限制、位置节流、振动开关、后台同步延迟和传感器状态。

An iPhone Duo style status indicator to show your battery, network, media status and more in a compact, minimal UI ideally around your camera with various items to show and gestures to interact with.

For foldable devices, Ensure to turn off 'Auto-detect camera' option if it's not reliable and manually align Duo with your inside and outside camera positions and then Essentials will remember your layout.

A dynamic island for your Android, around your camera cutout.

It brings live info together in one compact, expandable space: notifications with quick replies, media with album art and controls, calls, timers and stopwatches, alarms, calendar events, navigation, progress updates, hotspot and network status, connected devices, flashlight, sound mode, caffeinate, travel info and time and battery.

Third party apps can pair with the island to show their own live content, and you choose which ones are allowed.

Interact with simple gestures like tapping, swiping up and sliding along the island for volume, brightness and more, and assign your own tap actions.

Customize almost everything, including camera position and size with auto detect, width, placement, visuals like glow, outlines and pulse shadows, expanded size and roundness, display durations, what shows and when, hiding system heads up and status bar icons, and privacy options for locked screens.

It can also be combined with Duo for a single unified camera area.

Prevents accidental touches while your phone is in your pocket or bag.

When the proximity sensor is covered, Pocket mode shows a blocking screen so stray touches do nothing. Press any volume key to dismiss it. You can also use the light sensor along with proximity for better accuracy, add a trigger delay, and choose to only trigger while the device is locked.

Exclude apps where it should not trigger. It does not work while streaming or gaming by default.

Accessibility permission is required. On some devices with missing sensors, enabling it may break deep sleep and cause higher battery drain.

Get more control over your flashlight.

Adjust the brightness, fade it in and out smoothly, and use the volume keys to change the intensity. Show the brightness as a live update in the status bar.

Turn it off automatically when your phone is in a pocket, lower the brightness during long use to prevent overheating, or always turn it off, even while the display is on.

Brightness control needs hardware support that some devices lack.

Helps face unlock recognize you in the dark.

When the screen wakes up in low light, Essentials lights up the screen with a soft tinted glow so the front camera can see your face. You can set the ambient light threshold that decides when it kicks in, pick the light tint, and choose whether it illuminates automatically on wake-up or only when you trigger it.

It can also trigger the unlock for you. Accessibility permission is required.

Choose how links open instead of being stuck with one app.\n\nWhen you open a link, Essentials lets you pick between multiple apps to handle it, with the option to open it in a bubble, copy it, share it or shorten it and create a QR code.

Keep your wallpaper fresh with a daily curated wallpaper, or set a live wallpaper.\n\nPick your wallpaper, review and queue tomorrow\'s wallpaper before it is applied, and manage your live wallpaper from one place.

Integrations between your phone and your Wear OS watch.\n\nInstall the Essentials companion on your watch to sync notifications and calls, lock your phone from the watch, customize the watchface and complications, sync sound mode and location status, install an eSIM and turn on wireless debugging remotely.
Limit the system-wide download speed.\n\nUseful to stop large downloads and updates from using all of your bandwidth. Requires advanced permissions such as Shizuku or root.
Keeps mobile data active even while connected to Wi-Fi.\n\nThis lets your phone switch to mobile data instantly when the Wi-Fi connection gets weak or drops, at the cost of some extra battery use.
Shows the hidden wireless display certification options in Android\'s developer settings.\n\nThese options expose extra Wi-Fi display (Miracast) settings for testing and troubleshooting casting.
Rename the carrier display name shown for your active SIM cards.\n\nUseful to tell SIMs apart or to replace a carrier name you do not like. Requires advanced permissions such as Shizuku or root.
Turn on wireless debugging on your watch remotely from your phone.\n\nThis saves you from digging through the watch\'s developer options when you want to connect over ADB.

Install an eSIM on your Pixel Watch even in regions where it is not officially supported.\n\nExperimental. It relies on a hidden screen in the Pixel Watch app that may change, and installation success cannot be confirmed here.
Automatically keeps your watch sound mode in sync with your phone.\n\nWhen you switch your phone between sound, vibrate and silent, your watch follows.
Sends your Are we there yet status to your watch.\n\nThe status is shown in the device tile so you can see how close you are to your destination right from your wrist.
Lock your phone remotely from your watch.\n\nHandy if you left your phone somewhere and want to secure it right away.
Customize the controls shown on your watch.\n\nChoose which actions are available so the watch shows only what you need.
Customize the Essentials watchface on your Wear OS watch.\n\nChange its look and settings from your phone.
Customize the complication widgets shown on your watchface.\n\nChoose which info appears and where, such as flashlight status or other glance items.
Sync notifications between your phone and your watch.\n\nThis is only used for the launcher and is not a full notification mirror.
Sync call status between your phone and your watch.\n\nThis is only used for the launcher and is not a full call handler.
Quick Settings tile to toggle mono audio.\n\nMono audio plays the same sound in both ears, which helps when using a single earbud or if you have hearing difficulty in one ear.
Fine tune the system back gesture.\n\nAdjust the edge widths for the left and right gesture areas and set up per-app back gesture behavior. Requires secure settings permission.

Some devices, especially on One UI, pause app animations while the always-on display is showing and skip drawing app windows. This can leave the AOD wallpaper half transparent or invisible, or stuck on screen after waking the device.

Compatibility mode turns off the fade animations of the wallpaper. The wallpaper appears at full strength right away, disappears instantly when the screen wakes, and image changes are applied without a crossfade. Turn it on only if the wallpaper looks faded, never shows, or stays after waking.
